question: How is Bugenhagen's (1994) Mangap-Mbula entered beside Ross's (1988) consonant rows?
chosen_reading: Table 1 as Mangap's sourced inventory (prenasalised stops ᵐb ⁿd ᵑɡ beside oral b d ɡ, y = j); Table 3 and the voiced-stop statement (p. 51) as rows against POC by position (fortis/lenis initial, intervocalic, developed final), and the vowel rules 1-6 (pp. 53-59) as conditioned rows; Ross's rows are kept. Ross writes the prenasalised stops b, d, g (his orthography); Bugenhagen's mb, nd, ŋg are the same sounds.
alternatives: Enter only the inventory and leave the reflexes to Ross (1988).
